related.title: 電網儲能電池管理系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「夏季保留容量與市場容量」與「下垂控制與頻率響應」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；電網儲能電池管理系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Reserved and market capacity in summer" and "Droop control and frequency response" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grid Storage Battery Management Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用電池提高聯網線輸入能力的合約：夏季保留容量、短時過載所需的電量、機櫃配置、火災的隔離與套利；電網儲能電池管理系統則以看管五十萬顆電芯的系統：電壓精度與荷電狀態、均衡時間、資料量、過充保護與監控空窗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A battery contracted to raise interconnector import: summer reserved capacity, energy for short-term overload, cabinet layout, fire containment and arbitrage; Grid Storage Battery Management Systems centres on the system watching half a million cells: voltage accuracy and state of charge, balancing time, data volume, overcharge protection and monitoring gaps, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「功率、能量與時長」與「功率、能量與時長」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「功率轉換系統的交流電流」的模型移到電網儲能電池管理系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「過充保護的時間餘裕」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "AC current of the power conversion system" to Grid Storage Battery Management Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Time margin for overcharge protection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「夏季保留容量與市場容量」與「下垂控制與頻率響應」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；電網儲能電池管理系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Reserved and market capacity in summer" and "Droop control and frequency response" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grid Storage Battery Management Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 霍恩斯代爾儲能電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「夏季保留容量與市場容量」與「下垂控制與頻率響應」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩斯代爾儲能電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Reserved and market capacity in summer" and "Droop control and frequency response" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsdale Power Reserve must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用電池提高聯網線輸入能力的合約：夏季保留容量、短時過載所需的電量、機櫃配置、火災的隔離與套利；霍恩斯代爾儲能電站則以改變電網儲能觀念的大電池：頻率變化率、虛擬慣量、調頻成本與風場搭配為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A battery contracted to raise interconnector import: summer reserved capacity, energy for short-term overload, cabinet layout, fire containment and arbitrage; Hornsdale Power Reserve centres on the big battery that changed how grids see storage: rate of change of frequency, virtual inertia, frequency-control cost and pairing with wind, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「功率、能量與時長」與「功率、能量與時長」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「功率轉換系統的交流電流」的模型移到霍恩斯代爾儲能電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「虛擬慣量能提供的功率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "AC current of the power conversion system" to Hornsdale Power Reserve, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Power from virtual inertia", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「夏季保留容量與市場容量」與「下垂控制與頻率響應」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩斯代爾儲能電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Reserved and market capacity in summer" and "Droop control and frequency response" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsdale Power Reserve must be respecified.

history.title: 維多利亞大電池
history.text: 2020 年政府宣布興建計畫；2021 年試運轉時發生火災並於年底啟用；2032 年系統保全合約期滿。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2020: The government announced the project. 2021: A fire occurred in commissioning and the station opened at year end. 2032: The system integrity contract expires. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
